name: Futa Desire
source: Futa desire is a 18 + adult visual novel where the main protagonist comes back to his hometown after a very long time only to discover the dark secrets the people closest to him are hiding. How will our main protagonist react to the people around him?
translation: 《扶她之欲》是一部18+成人视觉小说：男主角阔别多年重返故乡，却意外发现了身边最亲近的人们各自隐藏的黑暗秘密。面对周围众人的真面目，男主角将会作何反应？
